items.source: Implementations perform the actual work of setting the actual values. They must implement the callback method setTypeValue which can throw SQLExceptions that will be caught and translated by the calling code. This callback method has access to the underlying Connection via the given PreparedStatement object, if that should be needed to create any database-specific objects.
items.translation: 实现负责执行设置实际值的实际工作。它们必须实现回调方法 setTypeValue，该方法可以抛出 SQLException，这些异常将被调用代码捕获并转换。如果需要通过给定的 PreparedStatement 对象创建任何数据库特定的对象，则该回调方法可以通过该对象访问底层 Connection。

items.source: Constant that indicates an unknown (or unspecified) SQL type. Passed into setTypeValue if the original operation method does not specify an SQL type.
items.translation: 指示未知（或未指定）SQL 类型的常量。如果原始操作方法未指定 SQL 类型，则将其传递给setTypeValue。

items.source: Set the type value on the given PreparedStatement.
items.translation: 在指定的 PreparedStatement 上设置类型值。
